primary_mechanism: Existing V7 entry-conditioned learned risk allocation combined with capital-proportional lot sizing

source_rules.source_label_join: Unique position_identifier within the exact candidate ledger; BIRTH supplies decision features and CLOSE supplies label/time. Reject missing, duplicate, partial or dropped evidence before fitting.
source_rules.same_second: A close label becomes eligible only when close server_time is strictly earlier than the next decision server_time. All same-second decisions use pre-update state.

periods.fit: entry >=2024-01-01, close <2025-01-01; never use a later-maturing label
periods.confirmation: 2026-01-01 <= entry, close <2026-07-01, opened only for one unchanged offline survivor
periods.binding_native: 2025-01-01 through 2026-07-01 exclusive at $100, 1:100, US30/US100/US500 complete real ticks
periods.conditional_recent_native: 2026-07-01 through 2026-09-01 exclusive, only after the long pair supports improvement
periods.known_exposure: Original V7/V8 whole and recent aggregate economics have already been seen. 2025 is selection, 2026 candidate-specific confirmation is locked. July/August is not globally pristine. No candidate fit-year performance is counted as out-of-sample.

model.kind: Ridge expected stressed risk-normalized return, exported as float32 standard ONNX tensor graph
model.raw_features: 14 columns: six component one-hot; six component-gated sign(feature)*log1p(abs(feature)); direction; direction*prior_signal_direction. All come from pre-entry V7 signal context. No realized outcome, entry fill slippage, future extrema or future availability enters features.
model.normalization: Fit-only column mean and population standard deviation; constant columns use scale 1; standardized inputs clipped to [-5,5]. Frozen in ONNX.
model.target: CLOSE stressed_net_usd / BIRTH planned_risk_usd, clipped [-2,2] for fitting/online labels only. Economic reports preserve unclipped outcomes.

online.kind: Per-component exponentially weighted residual correction around frozen ONNX output
online.native_labels: Only own complete realized trades; entry prediction stored with position identifier. No rejected-opportunity or counterfactual labels.
online.offline_limit: Original control completed labels are an observed teacher population, not the changed native candidate's own outcome path. This distribution/selection limitation cannot prove economic growth.
online.checkpoint: Own tester namespace checkpoint includes model identity, completed-label count, per-component biases and pending own entries/labels. No Live or retired state adoption.
online.inference_or_state_fault: Block new candidate entries and record engineering fault; never silently fall back to a profitable comparator. Existing owned protection/close remains active.

sizing.control: Exact original V7 +$150 daily stressed-balance lot staircase and 4%/12% risk, Passive 0.01
sizing.candidate_market_volume: floor_to_legal_step(0.01 * ConservativeRiskCapital()/100); minimum legal volume may be used only if original buffered position and aggregate risk and margin gates still pass
sizing.candidate_market_risk_fraction: 0.04 * clamp(0.75+0.5*tanh(score/0.25),0.25,1.0); score is ONNX prediction plus online bias only in online role
sizing.passive: Keep original 0.01 limit volume, geometry, risk and execution unchanged in this bundle; its complete labels may update its own residual but cannot influence other components.
sizing.stop: Original buffered protective-stop calculation with declared reduced position budget and declared new market volume. Changed stop distance is intentional; exact native evaluation is mandatory.
sizing.signals_exits: Keep original V7 opportunity generation, directions, management and exits. No novel entry or external input.

offline_selection.metrics: Both 2025 halves and whole: unclipped mean/sum risk-normalized return, predicted-score squared loss, weighted stressed R, weighted downside squared R and information ratio relative to unconditional control; complete sample counts and six-component breadth. No dollar profits or native DD claims.
offline_selection.eligibility: Both halves have positive weighted stressed R; pooled weighted stressed-R retention >=0.90; weighted stressed-R divided by sqrt(sum negative weighted R squared) exceeds unweighted control. At least 90% of each component's original count remains observed (no row filtering).
offline_selection.select: Choose highest eligible whole risk-efficiency; exact tie prefers online then static. Select at most one unchanged role. All roles close together if no survivor; no threshold/feature/model/hyperparameter rescue within this family.

confirmation_selection: One unchanged survivor only; same positive-half/stressed-retention/risk-efficiency evidence required on January-June, with online state carried causally from 2025 teacher observations. No retuning or alternate finalist after results.

native_decision.require: Immediately adjacent exact control and unchanged survivor with identical terminal, inputs, contracts/swaps and 100% required-symbol real ticks; complete reconciled actual/stressed ledgers, final state, equity DD and geometric growth.
native_decision.profit: Both actual and doubled-cost-stressed net exceed adjacent V7; every declared calendar epoch is positive in both valuations.
native_decision.dd_nominal: candidate native relative equity DD <= control
native_decision.dd_effective: min(control+1.5 percentage points, control*1.10), with exact miss disclosed and better robust recovery/temporal evidence required
native_decision.compounding: Compare $100 terminal wealth and annualized log growth on identical complete intervals; disclose drawdown duration, monthly returns and lot progression. Do not infer or guarantee a hockey-stick curve.
native_decision.recent: After supportive long result only, an unchanged adjacent July-August pair must retain positive actual/stressed pooled growth without material DD or execution deterioration; disclose both months.
